answer_2.quote: We use two evaluation metrics MRR, and Hits@N in experiments.

answer_4.quote: we invite annotators to manually annotate interpretability scores for all possible rules
answer_4.guideline: for every true path, we let the annotator choose one of the following three options, namely reasonable, partially reasonable, and unreasonable. These three options correspond to 1, 0.5, and 0 points of the interpretability score, respectively.
